text: “Mastering others is strength; mastering yourself is true power.”
Most of us measure strength outward:
who we can persuade, beat or impress.
The old text turns that around.
It is noticing what you do, and why.
You do not need to win an argument
Where could you practice self-mastery today?
This is the thread behind the book *The 14-Day Clarity Reset*.
A short daily practice for seeing yourself clearly.

text: “Thought is the talk of the soul with itself.”
Plato described thinking as a conversation
The tone shapes what you believe
the way you listen to anyone.
Today, notice one sentence you say to yourself
and ask if you would say it to a friend.
What tone does your inner conversation have today?
This is the thread behind the book *The Science of Learning Your Inner Speech*.
Hearing the conversation, then guiding it.

Reading is not agreeing.

Save this for the next thing you read.

From "Learn To Think For Yourself." Type the word "Think" and I'll send you the link.

#thinkforyourself #francisbacon #criticalthinking #reading #thinking

text: “Read not to contradict and confute; nor to believe and take for granted; but to weigh and consider.”
Bacon names two bad habits of readers.
One is reflex, the other is trust on autopilot.
Ask what is claimed, what supports it,
and what would change your mind.
and the voice in your own head.
What did you accept recently without weighing it?
This is the thread behind the book *Learn To Think For Yourself*.
Thinking it through before you take it in.

text: “Nothing is a better proof of a well ordered mind than a man’s ability to stop just where he is and pass some time in his own company.”
Seneca wrote this to a friend
is a skill, not a default.
It can feel restless at first.
What is left is often clearer
What do you notice when you stay with yourself?
This is the thread behind the book *The 14-Day Clarity Reset*.
A calm way to hear yourself think.
